structural_observations: A nonempty tools argument causes this exact Qwen template to inject the tool schema and tool-call instructions into the rendered system section; tools=[] omits that block.
OpenCode exposes the Fleet MCP tools to the model as fleet_bash and fleet_submit_report, while the training serializer admitted bare bash and submit_report calls.
The first divergence occurs before the user message completes, and the 874-token initial-context delta is therefore a prompt-contract difference rather than an assistant-output-only difference.
The measured deltas are fixture-specific magnitude evidence and must not be interpreted as corpus-wide token counts.
